test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Swindel'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us explore the meaning of the given options 
 
 
• Suspicious - having or showing a cautious distrust of someone or something.
 
• Swindel - There is no such word in English or we can say that there is a spelling mistake in the word. 
 
 
• ​If we interchange the last two letters in the word swindel, we get the word swindle.
 
• Swindle is a proper English word and it means use deception to deprive (someone) of money or possessions.
 
 
 
• Supplement - a thing added to something else in order to complete or enhance it.
 
• **Sweater**- a knitted garment worn on the upper body, typically with long sleeves, put on over the head.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
